title: 第一卷 第23章 顾天凡斩杀三人第一卷 第24章 灭门
slug: 我为族长当缔造诸天万界之禁忌家族
content_zh:
顾青云三人目瞪口呆地看着眼前的一幕，心中掀起了惊涛骇浪。
他们也没想到，顾天阳竟然强大到了这种地步！
灵海境的玄尘道人，在他手中竟然如此不堪一击！
顾天凡更是激动得浑身颤抖。
族长的强大，让他心中充满了无限的崇拜。
王嫣然瘫倒在地上，眼神呆滞，脸上满是恐惧和绝望。
她怎么也想不到，自己引以为傲的身份和背景。
在顾天阳面前竟然如此不值一提。
顾天阳目光落在王嫣然身上，眼中没有丝毫怜悯。
“你刚才说，要退婚？”
王嫣然浑身一颤，连忙磕头求饶。
“顾族长，我错了！”
“我不该狂妄自大，不该上门退婚，求您饶我一命！”
顾天阳嘴角勾起一抹冰冷的弧度。
“饶你一命？”
“你刚才对我顾家造成的羞辱，必须付出代价。”
此时，王嫣然再也没了青木宗真传弟子的骄傲。
只剩下深入骨髓的恐惧。
嘴里不停重复着求饶的话语，卑微到了极点。
顾天阳的目光淡漠地扫过瘫倒在地的王嫣然，转头看向身旁的顾天凡。

“天凡！”
“这三人，交给你处置。”
“你是顾家的弟子！”
“今日王家上门欺辱，妄图覆灭我顾家，这等血仇，理当由你亲手了结。”
“王嫣然毁约退婚，践踏顾家的尊严，王腾更是狼子野心，觊觎我顾家产业。”
“玄尘道人也是助纣为虐，他们的命，该由你亲自来取。”
“是，族长！”
顾天凡重重点头，周身气息骤然变得狂暴起来。
王嫣然听到这话，吓得魂飞魄散，挣扎着想要爬起来逃跑。
她抬起头，脸上满是绝望的哭腔。
“顾天凡，求求你，看在往日的情分上，饶我一命！”
“我再也不敢了，我愿意取消退婚，我愿意嫁给你！”
“往日情分？”
顾天凡冷笑一声，眼中满是鄙夷。
“你觉醒灵体，成为青木宗真传弟子时，怎么不想着往日情分？”
“你带着人上门退婚，羞辱我顾家时，怎么不想着往日情分？”
“王嫣然，你今日所受，皆是咎由自取！”
话音落下，顾天凡不再犹豫。
content_en:
Gu Qingyun and the others looked at the scene in front of them dumbfounded, and their hearts were filled with turmoil.
They didn't expect that Gu Tianyang would be so powerful!
Taoist Xuanchen, who was in the Linghai Realm, was so vulnerable in his hands!
Gu Tianfan was so excited that his whole body trembled.
The strength of the clan leader filled his heart with infinite admiration.
Wang Yanran collapsed on the ground, her eyes dull, her face full of fear and despair.
She never imagined that she was proud of her identity and background.
In front of Gu Tianyang, he was so insignificant.
Gu Tianyang's eyes fell on Wang Yanran, without any mercy in his eyes.
"You just said you wanted to break off the engagement?"
Wang Yanran trembled all over and kowtowed quickly to beg for mercy.
"Clan Leader Gu, I was wrong!"
"I shouldn't be arrogant or come to break off the engagement. Please spare my life!"
The corners of Gu Tianyang's mouth curved into a cold arc.
"Spare your life?"
"You must pay the price for the humiliation you just caused to my Gu family."
At this time, Wang Yanran no longer had the pride of being a true disciple of the Qingmu Sect.
All that remains is the deep-seated fear.
He kept repeating the words of begging for mercy, and he was extremely humble.
Gu Tianyang's eyes swept over Wang Yanran who was collapsed on the ground indifferently, and then turned to look at Gu Tianfan beside him.
"Tianfan!"
"These three people are at your disposal."
"You are a disciple of the Gu family!"
"Today the Wang family came to bully me and tried to destroy my Gu family. This kind of blood feud should be ended by you yourself."
"Wang Yanran broke the contract and broke off the engagement, trampling on the dignity of the Gu family. Wang Teng is even more ambitious and covets my Gu family property."
"Taoist Xuanchen is also helping the emperor to do evil. It is up to you to take their lives yourself."
"Yes, patriarch!"
Gu Tianfan nodded heavily, and the aura around him suddenly became violent.
When Wang Yanran heard this, she was so frightened that she struggled to get up and escape.
She raised her head, her face full of desperate cries.
"Gu Tianfan, please, for the sake of past friendship, spare my life!"
"I don't dare anymore, I am willing to cancel the engagement, and I am willing to marry you!"
"Past love?"
Gu Tianfan sneered, his eyes full of contempt.
"When you awakened your spirit body and became a true disciple of the Aoki Sect, why didn't you think about your past feelings?"
"When you brought someone to your door to break off the engagement and humiliated my Gu family, why didn't you think about the past relationship?"
"Wang Yanran, what you have suffered today is all your own fault!"
After the words fell, Gu Tianfan no longer hesitated.
